an5.195:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.195:1.2: tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni licchavisatāni bhagavantaṃ payirupāsanti
an5.195:1.3: appekacce licchavī nīlā honti nīlavaṇṇā nīlavatthā nīlālaṅkārā appekacce licchavī pītā honti pītavaṇṇā pītavatthā pītālaṅkārā appekacce licchavī lohitakā honti lohitakavaṇṇā lohitakavatthā lohitakālaṅkārā appekacce licchavī odātā honti odātavaṇṇā odātavatthā odātālaṅkārā
an5.195:1.4: tyassudaṃ bhagavā atirocati vaṇṇena ceva yasasā ca
an5.195:2.1: athakho piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.195:2.2: paṭibhāti maṃ bhagavā paṭibhāti maṃ sugatāti.
an5.195:2.4: athakho piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo bhagavato sammukhā sārūpāya gāthāya abhitthavi
an5.195:4.1: athakho te licchavī pañcahi uttarāsaṅgasatehi piṅgiyāniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ acchādesuṃ.
an5.195:4.2: athakho piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo tehi pañcahi uttarāsaṅgasatehi bhagavantaṃ acchādesi.
an5.195:5.2: pañcannaṃ licchavī ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.195:5.4: tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.195:5.5: tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.195:5.6: tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.195:5.7: tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā dhammānudhammapaṭipanno puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ
an5.195:5.9: imesaṃ kho licchavī pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasminti.
